def fn(t0, t1, t2, k, lst, dct):
    v1 = torch.slice_scatter(t0, t1[1:3:3, :], dim=0, start=1, end=3, step=3)
    v1.add_(0)
    t2.fill_(1)
    v2 = t2.permute(0, 1, 2)
    t1.add_(t1.flip(1))
    t1[t1 > 2] = k
    v3 = t0.narrow(1, 0, 1)
    t0.copy_(t1)
    v4 = v3.transpose(1, 0)
    return (v1, v4, t0, lst, dct)
